w: At 5.05 pm, Swamishri landed at Kuwait International Airport. Swamishri and sadhus were welcomed by Dr. Mukesh Delwadiya, Harish Derasari and other devotees.

During the evening assembly Swamishri blessed the devotees, saying, "Inner peace cannot be attained through a predominance of mundane affairs. By prioritizing satsang in one's life one finds peace of mind... The human birth and this satsang is priceless. We have this human body, but through satsang and the God-communion sadhu one comes to understand how to use it to attain moksha..."

Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of the canvas murtis of Shri Akshar Prurushottam Maharaj and the Guru Parampara for the renovated Hari mandir in the township of Shankartekari in Jamnagar city.
At 10. 55 a.m. Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals in the Swaminarayan hari mandir in the suburb of Kapadiyanagar, Mahuva.
